description: E-BOOTSTRAP-UNSUPPORTED (INTERIM): a value `if` branch with statements before its `lift`.
rationale: §17.6.1 admits `{ statement* lift-stmt statement* }`; the bootstrap builds a branch that is one value (§17.6.8's single-lift form) and refuses the rest by name. Capable form: an expression kind for the value `if`, lowered assign-in-branches (§17.6.8).
